meta.title: Brazil TV Aberta + Bonus - Working IPTV (tested)
meta.test_method: HTTP GET master playlist, check status 200 + content-type application/vnd.apple.mpegurl + body contains #EXTM3U, parse RESOLUTION. Tested from Code Mode runtime.
meta.player_notes: All URLs are HLS master/variant playlists. Play with mpv, VLC, ffplay, Kodi, TiviMate, IPTV Smarters, hls.js / video.js. Example: mpv <url> or ffplay <url>. No MPEG-DASH (.mpd) found stable for BR aberta in this sweep - everything working is HLS, which matches your HLS-first preference.
meta.important_caveat: Globo nacional, SBT nacional, Record nacional and Band nacional via unofficial mirror host 170.84.165.204 (BAND_HD, Globo_HD, SBT_HD, Record_HD) currently return 403, and Band Sports / BandNews via cdn-5.nxplay return 403. Official Globoplay / SBT / PlayPlus / BandPlay use token/DRM/login and have no stable open 1080p HLS. Working Globo entry here is TV Morena Dourados (Globo affiliate MS). Working SBT entry here is SBT News (official Google DAI) + SBT Interior (JMV).
